thread:
Anna - Marketing: Quick sync — finalizing registration page + Zoom/recording plan for next week's micro-webinar. Who can own the recording flow and post-event edits?
Sam - Events Ops: I can own recording + SRT. Will set cloud recording + auto transcript. Need clarity on edit owners though.
Jordan - Content: I can own the highlight clips and the 3-min demo edit. ETA 48h after recording.
Lia - Growth: I'll own lead routing + follow-up email template. We should also lock the HubSpot list name and UTM params.
Priya - Legal: Add me for the consent checkbox text. We need explicit processing notice for EU registrants. Short line works.
Anna - Marketing: Great. Sam, can you confirm Zoom settings? Add separate audio files? low-latency mode?
Sam - Events Ops: Proposed Zoom config (will apply to the meeting template):
```
Cloud recording: ON (record active speaker + gallery)
Auto-transcribe audio: ON (English)
Record separate audio files: OFF
Optimize for: Shared screen (if slides)
Enable local recording for hosts only: OFF
RTMP fallback: enabled
Waiting room: OFF for panelists, ON for attendees
```
Sam - Events Ops: Also enabling "Allow live streaming to custom service" for RTMP fallback if Zoom cloud hiccups.
ZoomBot: Meeting scheduled: "Redwood Micro Webinar: Serving LLMs at Scale" 2026-04-08 10:00 PDT. Cloud recording + transcripts: enabled.
Jordan - Content: For edits: I'll output 1 keynote clip (2-3m), 3 social snippets (30s), and the full trimmed recording. Where should final assets land?
Anna - Marketing: Upload final assets to the marketing S3 bucket under `events/2026-04-08-microwebinar/` and drop links in this thread. Tag owners in the doc.
Lia - Growth: HubSpot naming: list = "microwebinar_2026_04_08_attendees", lifecycle sync = webinar -> MQL if attended >= 5 mins. Follow-up cadence: immediate replay + 3-day nurture. Draft subject: "Thanks for joining — replay + highlights".
Priya - Legal: Consent text suggestion: "By registering you consent to Redwood Inference processing your info for event communication and follow-up. See our Privacy Policy." Add checkbox label: "I agree to receive follow-up emails." Must show link to privacy policy.
Sam - Events Ops: One more operational note — enable attendee live transcript download? Zoom setting requires cloud transcript on; I'll also request SRT export.
Jordan - Content: Requesting a dedicated transcript export (SRT + VTT) so captions can be burned/subbed during edit. Sam, can you confirm export path?
Sam - Events Ops: Will export SRT/VTT to `s3://redwood-marketing/events/2026-04-08-microwebinar/transcripts/` and tag the files with meeting ID.
Lia - Growth: For the follow-up email, can we include a one-click CTA to request a Dedicated demo? (short form pre-filled) Also add UTM_source=webinar, utm_campaign=microwebinar_apr2026.
Anna - Marketing: Yes. Jordan will supply clip timestamps for the 30s assets. Lia will add CTAs. Sam will drop the raw recording + SRT within 12 hours. Jordan gets 48h for final edits.
Priya - Legal: Make sure the registration page includes country field for data residency flags. EU registrants should see the processing checkbox and a note about data transfer if needed.
Sam - Events Ops: Quick preflight checklist before we go live tomorrow:
- Confirm meeting template applied
- Test RTMP fallback (10 min stress test)
- Verify cloud recording + transcript capture
- Confirm S3 write perms for export user
- Confirm panelist webcams + mic checks
Sam - Events Ops: I'll run the stress test today at 3pm PT and post results here.
Anna - Marketing: Sounds good. Jordan/Lia, please share the draft follow-up copy by EOD so Priya can check legal language.
Jordan - Content: Will post draft follow-up copy here by 5pm.
Lia - Growth: I'll add the HubSpot list and prepopulate the CTA form + UTM. Posting list name and form ID after Sam confirms export path.
Anna - Marketing: Thanks team — love the quick alignment. :rocket:
Sam - Events Ops: Stress test done: RTMP fallback OK, cloud recording stable, transcript latency ~18s. Uploaded sample SRT to `s3://redwood-marketing/events/2026-04-08-microwebinar/transcripts/sample.srt`.
Jordan - Content: Received SRT. Starting rough cut.
Lia - Growth: HubSpot list created: microwebinar_2026_04_08_attendees (form id: 8f7a3). Routing rule: attend>5min -> add to MQL queue.
Priya - Legal: Approved consent language. Small tweak: replace "follow-up emails" with "event-related communications".
Anna - Marketing: Final note — after assets up, please tag costs in the console (ad credits, editing vendor). We'll run attribution against the UTM campaign.
Jordan - Content: Will drop final edit links here when done.
Sam - Events Ops: Final raw + SRT uploaded and permissions open. Link: https://s3.console.aws.amazon.com/s3/object/redwood-marketing/events/2026-04-08-microwebinar/raw/recording.mp4
Anna - Marketing: Closing thread — thanks everyone. We'll reopen if any post-event snags come up. :thumbsup:
